scope: Validation of the refreshed three walkthroughs only; no comparisons with older application revisions.
source_pipeline: Lossless 2x Chromium PNG capture of the actual built application; real clicks, hover and scrolling with measured frame timestamps
fixture: Capture used a disposable, marked Alex Morgan fictional workspace on loopback.
encoding: Lossless 2x PNG source; no WebM, JPEG or spatial resizing. 256-colour GIF with no dithering, source timestamps rounded to GIF centiseconds, unchanged frames represented as reading holds, and frame-difference compression. No synthetic frames or interpolation.
checks: Every captured source PNG hash and native 2x dimensions match its provenance record.
Every GIF frame decoded, dimensions match source, loop is infinite, and file is below 10 MB.
Static posters preserve source PNG pixels at native dimensions.
All three walkthrough img tags retain width caps and omit fixed height attributes; all three reduced-motion still sources remain.
Current posters and decoded GIF action-state contact sheets were visually inspected with their native aspect ratios preserved.
poster_error_metric: Best matching decoded GIF frame versus its PNG poster, both resized to the intended display width using Lanczos; RGB mean squared error. This measures palette encoding error, not usability or animation smoothness.
limitations: The lossless source is sampled at the measured capture rate rather than the browser refresh rate; short transitions can span only a few captured frames.
GIF uses a 256-colour palette and centisecond timing. PNG posters preserve source pixels.
The walkthroughs show the full local application; they do not verify the read-only public deployment or prove a real application was sent.

visual_review.result: The charcoal/lavender design, legible sample content, persistent review controls, document preview and return-to-shortlist states remain visible without stretched assets.
visual_review.scope: Poster review and sampled action states; this is not a claim of production accessibility conformance or full-refresh-rate animation validation.
